The prior session stopped before it could finish the readiness check. I completed that check; **SKI-19 is well scoped, but its package upgrade is not ready to complete yet.**

[MCP-4’s fix merged in PR #204](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/pull/204), and upstream source now declares McpFn **0.0.5**. The PR explicitly did not publish npm packages. A live registry check still shows **0.0.4** as latest for `@mcpfn/core`, `@mcpfn/auth`, and `@mcpfn/testing`, so SKI-19’s published-package acceptance criterion remains blocked.

The Skillplane checkout is clean and unchanged. It still pins 0.0.4. The redundant `allow_eval_during_startup` flag is present in [the local MCP config](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/agent/experiments/skillplane/mcp/wrangler.jsonc:6), the development and production templates, and [the topology generator](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/agent/experiments/skillplane/scripts/lib/topology-deployment.mjs:100). I found no consumer-side Zod alias to remove in this checkout.

**Recommendation:** the flag and test cleanup can be prepared now. Finish the dependency upgrade, workerd startup proof, and controlled development deployment after 0.0.5 is published. None of those checks has been run for the patched release in Skillplane yet.
